sig: [[["A", "Hi Nathan, I need to set up performance reviews for my team. HR wants them done by the end of the month, right?"], ["B", "Actually, Sophie, the deadline's been brought forward to the 24th, because payroll needs the ratings for the January pay raises."], ["A", "Oh, I hadn't heard that. That only gives me two weeks, and I've got seven people to see."], ["B", "Each meeting should take about forty-five minutes. Want me to book them for you?"], ["A", "That'd be a huge help. Could you avoid Mondays? I'm in client meetings all day."], ["B", "Sure. I'll spread them over Tuesday to Thursday. And remember, each person needs to submit a self-assessment beforehand."], ["A", "Where do they do that?"], ["B", "In the HR portal, under 'Reviews'. I'll send everyone a reminder with the link."], ["A", "Thanks. Oh, and can you book room 4B? It's quieter than the others."], ["B", "I'll check if it's free and send you the calendar invites by tomorrow."]], {"A": "F-GB", "B": "M-AU"}]
